summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K reporting routine administrative disclosures under UK listing rules, including voting rights and capital updates, share issuances, and transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities. The filing consists of multiple press releases covering standard corporate housekeeping matters such as share buybacks, admission of transferable securities, and notifications under DTR 5.6.1. No special situation event—acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or similar—is present. The registrant acts solely as the issuer of these routine disclosures. This is a routine current report with no actionable special-situation content.
